one_line: A woman on a sofa with popcorn, a lollipop, gummies and marshmallows on the table holds each one up to camera and says, in a repeated pattern, that it is a choking hazard and children should not eat it until age five.

hook.visual: Medium shot of a woman in a beige blazer seated on a cream sofa, a coffee table in front of her loaded with a bowl of popcorn and bags of sweets (a candy brand's gummy bears, a tube of jelly beans, marshmallows, a fruit-flavoured lollipop pack); she speaks straight to camera from 0.0 s.
hook.on_screen_text: הריל הבא נועד להציל חיים! ⚠️⚠️ (This reel is meant to save lives!)
hook.first_spoken_line: Whisper heard "הרעיל הבא נועד להציל חיים". The on-screen text reads "הריל הבא נועד להציל חיים!", so Whisper misheard 'הריל' (this reel) as 'הרעיל' (the poison). (This reel is meant to save lives.)
hook.why_it_stops_the_scroll: Inferred: a warning triangle and a blunt life-saving claim in the first 2 seconds, with a table of sweets that every parent recognises, creates a 'is my child at risk?' question that is only answered by watching all four items.

beats.observed: Seated on a sofa behind a coffee table of popcorn and sweets, the speaker addresses the camera; text box with warning emojis.
beats.spoken: Whisper: the next reel is meant to save lives.
beats.on_screen_text: הריל הבא נועד להציל חיים! ⚠️⚠️ (This reel is meant to save lives!)

beats.observed: She holds a single popcorn kernel up between thumb and finger while leaning on one knee.
beats.spoken: Whisper: popcorn can be inhaled into the windpipe, swell and cause choking; up to age five it is not eaten.
beats.on_screen_text: פופקורן יכול / להשאף לקנה הנשימה / ולגרום לחנק / עד גיל חמש (Popcorn can be inhaled into the windpipe and cause choking, until age five)

beats.observed: A red diagonal graphic appears across her torso at 9.0 s as she holds her hand up in a 'stop' gesture. She picks up a green lollipop on a white stick and shows it to camera; the framing punches in at 12.0-13.5 s.
beats.spoken: Whisper: the danger of a lollipop on a stick is that it can detach from the stick and block the airway; lollipops and other hard candy are not consumed until age five.
beats.on_screen_text: לא אוכלים אותו (We don't eat it) / עלול להתנתק ולחסום קנה / אסור לצרוך סוכריות קשות אחרות (It can detach and block the windpipe / Do not consume other hard candy)

beats.observed: She puts the lollipop down and gestures with an open hand; another red slash graphic is visible at 19.5 s.
beats.spoken: Whisper (cut off): and if you ask me, also don't eat...

beats.observed: She holds two gummy sweets (one red, one gold) between her fingertips, in a tighter close-up from 24.0 s; red slash graphic at 30.0 s.
beats.spoken: Whisper: gummy sweets are hard to chew, they can slip into the airway and stick; do not consume gummies until age five.
beats.on_screen_text: סוכריות גומי / הן קשות ללעיסה / ולהידבק / אסור לצרוך סוכריות / גומי עד גיל חמש (Gummy sweets / they are hard to chew / and stick / Do not consume gummy sweets until age five)

beats.observed: She squeezes a white marshmallow between both hands to show how it squashes and sticks; marshmallow bags on the table.
beats.spoken: Whisper: marshmallow is hard to chew in the mouth, sticky, may stick to the airway and block it.
beats.on_screen_text: מרשמלו הוא קשה / לעיבוד בחלל לפה / עלול להידבק לקנה / הנשימה ולחסום (Marshmallow is hard to process in the mouth cavity, may stick to the windpipe and block it)

beats.observed: She stops holding items, clasps her hands in front of her chest, looks into the camera with a serious face; the video ends on that held pose.
beats.spoken: Whisper: up to age five we do not eat marshmallow.
beats.on_screen_text: עד גיל חמש / לא אוכלים מרשמלו (Until age five / we do not eat marshmallow)

payoff: The viewer gets four named foods and one rule per item (not until age five) at 2.2 s, 8.8 s, 21.9 s and 30.1 s, with the closing verdict at 39 s. There is no explicit final summary or CTA in the video itself.
cta: None in the video. The caption asks the viewer to pass it on: "תעבירי את זה לחברה שצריכה לשמוע את זה🙏🏻" (Pass this on to a friend who needs to hear this), and adds that sweets are not recommended at any age.
share_or_comment_trigger: Inferred: a safety warning with named everyday foods that parents give their toddlers; the explicit 'send to a friend who needs to hear it' line gives a reason to share and the topic invites disagreement about the age limit, which could drive the 287 comments.
why_it_worked: 477,499 views against a median of 23,828 (outlier_x 20.0) with a like_rate of 1.15%: a choking-hazard message in the first second matches a universal parent fear (inferred from numbers and hook).
A repeating pattern (hold the item up, say why, name the age, burn a red slash) makes each of the four items a mini-payoff, so the viewer keeps watching for the next food (observed).
Real, named, branded sweets on a table make it concrete and recognisable, and the caption's 'pass it to a friend' line explicitly asks for the share (observed).
paid_signal: no | like_rate 1.15% is well above the 0.3% flag and the outlier size is modest (20x).

solo_route.how: 1) Barter with a credentialed expert (a speech therapist, early-literacy educator or pediatric nurse) for free personalised books in exchange for filming one 40-second clip. 2) Give the expert a template: a 'this reel is meant to...' opener, then 3-4 items held to camera, one rule per item with the age. 3) Film on a phone on a sofa or a table with props, then in CapCut add the word-chunk burned-in captions, a red slash graphic on each 'no', and punch-in cuts. 4) Put a 'send this to a friend who needs it' line in the caption, not in the video.
solo_route.needs: A barter expert who signs off on every claim and age limit; a safety claim cannot be delivered by a 24-year-old without kids.

lumebook_version.hook_he: הריל הבא יחסוך לכם ספר שהילד לא יסתכל עליו (This reel will save you a book your child won't look at)
lumebook_version.concept: An early-literacy expert (barter) holds three books or LumeBook sample pages, one per age band, and says in one sentence each what the child at that age can follow (the expert provides the claims). Caption: 'send to a friend who has a kid turning X'.

evidence_notes: Observed: the speaker, the table of foods, the lollipop and gummies, the red slash graphic at 9.0, 19.5 and 30.0 s, the burned-in word-chunk subtitles, and the punch-in framing changes at 13.5, 24.0 and 27.0 s. Spoken: Whisper is mostly aligned with the on-screen text but misheard 'הריל' as 'הרעיל', 'קנה' as 'קנאי' and 'שהיא' as 'שאלולה', and cut off the sentence at 18.96-21.9 s ('גם לא אוכלי'); I used the on-screen text for quotes. Inferred: made_by 'expert_self' comes from the account name, which lists nutrition, parenting, sleep and potty training; no credential is shown or stated in the video. Not verified: the 'until age five' safety claim and the claim that lollipops and gummies must not be consumed before five. The caption says sweets are not recommended at any age, which is stronger than what is said in the video. The speaker is not identified beyond the account name.
